errors.message: Streamable HTTP error: Error POSTing to endpoint: {"error":"invalid_token","error_description":"LyricalWriter MCP requires authentication. EITHER connect via OAuth (clients that support MCP authorization can just sign in — discovery metadata is advertised in the WWW-Authenticate header) OR send a personal API key as \"Authorization: Bearer lw_...\". The user can create a key at https://lyricalwriter.com/settings under Settings → API Keys (a LyricalWriter account is required — sign up at https://lyricalwriter.com). If a credential was provided, it may be invalid, revoked, or expired — sign in again or create a fresh key."}
